sql: SELECT strftime(first_ts, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%fZ') AS first, strftime(last_ts, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%fZ') AS last FROM corpus_stats WHERE dataset = $1
SELECT count(*) AS total FROM log_events_idx WHERE log_events_idx.message @@ ts_phrase($1) AND log_events_idx.dataset = $2

WITH hits AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT log_events_idx.event_id, log_events_idx.dataset, strftime(log_events_idx.ts, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%fZ') AS ts, log_events_idx.component, log_events_idx.level, log_events_idx.node, log_events_idx.alert_label, log_events_idx.request_id, log_events_idx.host, log_events_idx.process_id, log_events_idx.client_ip, log_events_idx.thread, log_events_idx.block_id, left(log_events_idx.message, 400) AS message, length(log_events_idx.message) > 400 AS message_truncated, BM25(log_events_idx.tableoid) AS score FROM log_events_idx WHERE log_events_idx.message @@ ts_phrase($1) AND log_events_idx.dataset = $2 ORDER BY log_events_idx.ts, log_events_idx.event_id LIMIT $3) SELECT hits.*, matches.match_offsets FROM hits JOIN (SELECT log_events_idx.event_id, ts_offsets(log_events_idx.message) AS match_offsets FROM log_events_idx WHERE log_events_idx.message @@ ts_phrase($1) AND CASE WHEN log_events_idx.event_id IN (SELECT event_id FROM hits) THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END) AS matches ON hits.event_id = matches.event_id ORDER BY hits.ts, hits.event_id
